messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — found two places in the migration guide where v1 model names still show up (text-curie -> redwood-base-curie). I'll open quick PRs but need someone to verify examples and check SDK snippets.
Priya: thanks, @Alex. Can you paste the lines? I can patch the TS snippets.
Alex: pasted the lines:
```
const res = client.models.generate('text-curie', { prompt })
```
should be
```
const res = client.responses.create({ model: 'redwood-base-curie', input: prompt })
```
Priya: ok I'll update and run the snippet tests.
Samir: FYI the code-sandbox example also has the old embed model name. I'll add it to the PR. Also we need to add a short callout in the migration guide about model aliasing and fallback behavior.
Maria: Suggest adding a note about the v1 -> v2 difference in response streaming API. Small blurb under 'Breaking changes'?
Alex: yes. I'll draft one-liner. @Ryan can you review the wording for the "compatibility" section?
Ryan: on it, can review in ~2 hrs. Also we should update the changelog entry and release-note snippet.
Docs-Bot: Created PR #3421 (alex/docs/migration-model-names) — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 :robot_face:
Priya: linking the snippet runner logs: https://ci.redwood/123/logs — failing because sample tests expect old response shape. I'll add a test fixer in the PR.
Samir: small question — do we need to backpatch to v1 docs? customers on Dedicated might still be on older runtime.
Alex: add a short "If you're on Dedicated v1 runtime" note, and ping eng-runtime for rollout dates. @eng-runtime
EngRuntimeBot: Noted. Targeting runtime upgrade window 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-18. We'll send a compatibility matrix.
Maria: I'll add a small paragraph and an example for the fallback config (model_aliases) with a code snippet.
Alex: Great. After PR merges we should add a redirect from /v1/migrate -> /v2/migrate. Who wants to handle the redirect?
Priya: I can add the Netlify redirect rule in the PR.
Ryan: Reviewed and left minor wording comments on the PR.
Alex: cool — plan: open small PRs for snippets + redirect + changelog. Merge order: snippets -> tests -> redirect -> changelog. Tagging for review: @Priya, @Ryan, @Samir, @Maria
Priya: ack :white_check_mark:
Samir: ack :+1:
Alex: thanks everyone. Will update thread when PRs merge.
